article.title: Six Ways to Thrive in Zombie Times
article.author: Shilpa Jain
article.content: Making it through each day, especially since the 2024 election, has been unspeakably hard. We–Shilpa and Jodi–decided to write this piece to support ourselves and others with not just surviving these times, but also widening our perspectives, shoring up our personal and collective power, and feeding the mysterious yet essential creative fire.
